## Answer guidance

Requirements and processing times depend on the service, authority and individual case. Visitors should contact AJFAN Documents Clearing before relying on a general checklist, especially for visa, immigration, attestation and business setup matters.

## Direct answers

Q: What does AJFAN Documents Clearing do?
A: AJFAN Documents Clearing helps individuals, families, entrepreneurs and companies with UAE visa services, PRO procedures, typing, document clearing, MOFA attestation, translation, corporate support and business setup.

Q: Where is AJFAN Documents Clearing located?
A: AJFAN Documents Clearing is based at Shams Business Centre, Media City Free Zone, Al Messaned, Sharjah, United Arab Emirates, and supports clients across Sharjah, Dubai and the UAE.

Q: How can I contact AJFAN Documents Clearing?
A: Call 0529812786, email ajfantyping@gmail.com or send the requirement on WhatsApp at https://wa.me/971529812786.

Q: Can AJFAN review documents before processing?
A: Yes. Send the available document copies and explain the requirement. The team will review the case and confirm the applicable next steps and requirements.
